description: Tariq Corporation Limited was incorporated in Karachi on 14 February 1966, began commercial production on 15 February 1968 and is one of the pioneers of Pakistan's sugar industry. Its plant at Jaranwala, about 80 km from Lahore and 40 km from Faisalabad, uses a defecation remelt sulphitation process that replaced double carbonation double sulphitation in 1986-87. The company has twice been named among Pakistan's Top 25 Companies and states that it is now run by the third generation of its founding family.
